_about: Facial emote library for the base bodies (see README.md for the Exp_* morphs and bones).
morphs: Exp_* shape key -> weight 0..1. Every emote is a combination; no single shape at full strength.
jaw_deg: rotation of the jaw bone about its local X axis in degrees (positive opens, ~20 = fully open).
eyes: optional. Either {yaw, pitch} in degrees applied to both eye_l and eye_r (yaw > 0 looks to the
character's left, pitch > 0 looks up; local Z then local X of the eye bones) or {converge: metres}
which aims each eye at a point that far in front of the face so the eyes focus together.
borderlands_default_face is NOT an emote: it is the slider preset for the game's base look and is
applied underneath every emote. Preview sheets: Tools/Blender/render_emotes.py.

borderlands_default_face.description: Character-creator slider defaults for the Borderlands-style base look. Applied once on top of the neutral mesh; emotes layer over it.

emotes.name: Neutral
emotes.description: Rest face, eyes focused on something 0.6 m ahead (the player). Base for idle and the return pose after every emote.

emotes.name: Happy
emotes.description: Open grin with raised cheeks; eyes narrowed by the smile, brows lifted a touch.

emotes.name: Laugh
emotes.description: Head-back belly laugh: jaw dropped, wide grin, eyes squeezed almost shut.

emotes.name: Smirk
emotes.description: One-sided knowing smile: lips parted to one side, one brow cocked, opposite eye narrowed.

emotes.name: Sad
emotes.description: Inner brows pulled up, corners of the mouth down, heavy lids, gaze dropped.

emotes.name: Cry
emotes.description: Sobbing: brows knotted up, eyes screwed shut, mouth stretched down with the jaw slack.

emotes.name: Angry
emotes.description: Lowered brows, flared nostrils, mouth pressed into a hard frown. Jaw clenched, no shouting yet.

emotes.name: Rage
emotes.description: Shout: jaw wide, upper lip snarled off the teeth, brows crushed down over wide eyes, neck tendons out.

emotes.name: Fear
emotes.description: Eyes wide and brows pulled up in the middle, mouth stretched open in a gasp, neck tight.

emotes.name: Surprise
emotes.description: Brows and eyes thrown wide open, mouth dropped into an 'oh'.

emotes.name: Disgust
emotes.description: Nose scrunched and sneering, upper lip raised, brows down and eyes narrowed. 'That smells.'

emotes.name: Contempt
emotes.description: One nostril and lip corner lifted, lips pressed, one eye narrowed; gaze slides off to the side.

emotes.name: Pain
emotes.description: Hit reaction: eyes clenched, brows knotted, nose scrunched, teeth bared in a grimace, neck tense.

emotes.name: Confused
emotes.description: Sceptical: one brow arched high, the other pulled down over a narrowed eye, mouth pulled to the side.

emotes.name: Tired
emotes.description: Half-closed eyes, slack mouth, brows drooping up in the middle; gaze low.

emotes.name: Wink
emotes.description: Left eye shut with a cheeky half-smile; the open side's brow lifts.

emotes.name: Determined
emotes.description: Brows down, eyes narrowed, lips pressed into a hard line. Ready to fight.

emotes.name: Flirty
emotes.description: Bedroom eyes: lids lowered, small smile with a hint of pucker, one brow up, sideways glance.

emotes.name: Bored
emotes.description: Lids half down, eyes rolled up and away, mouth flat and slightly pressed.

emotes.name: Talking_A
emotes.description: Viseme 'ah': jaw dropped a little with the lips relaxed apart.

emotes.name: Talking_E
emotes.description: Viseme 'ee': lips stretched wide and parted over the teeth.

emotes.name: Talking_O
emotes.description: Viseme 'oh/oo': lips funnelled forward with the jaw slightly open.

emotes.name: Talking_M
emotes.description: Viseme 'm/b/p': lips pressed together.

emotes.name: Blink
emotes.description: Both lids closed (the 1.0 of a 0 -> 1 -> 0 blink curve); brows unchanged.

emotes.name: Eyes_Left
emotes.description: Both eyes turned to the character's left (yaw +22), lids unchanged.

emotes.name: Eyes_Right
emotes.description: Both eyes turned to the character's right (yaw -22), lids unchanged.

emotes.name: Eyes_Up
emotes.description: Both eyes looking up (pitch +18); upper lids and brows follow a little.

emotes.name: Eyes_Down
emotes.description: Both eyes looking down (pitch -18); upper lids follow the gaze down.

emotes.name: Asleep
emotes.description: Eyes closed and relaxed (not squeezed), brows soft, jaw slack with lips parted.
